scope: Post-selection regression Gate B for Olli's locked social-caption candidate and the transparent Golden Homepage composition.

T1StripTest.evidence: The open halftone proof rail, centered proof statement and profile hierarchy remain legible without a section fill, gradient, glow or card shell.

T2ComponentRepetitionTest.evidence: Removing the recessed plate reduces section-container repetition; whitespace now carries the transition from hero to proof to problem.

T3MotionComparisonTest.evidence: At 1440 the locked homepage rail advanced 30.5px in 1.25s and the single visible portrait video advanced approximately 1.257s across its loop boundary.

T4RealContentTest.evidence: The locked page still renders seven supplied testimonials, seven local portraits and curated local profile images with no Daniel placeholder or social link.

canonScan.notes: Transparent canvas inheritance fixes the isolated off-white plate without adding a default cluster. The only exception remains Olli's recorded CMP-06 continuous-drift decision.

findings.finding: The recessed surface made GH-S08 read as an independent container instead of part of the homepage flow.
findings.resolution: The section background is transparent and inherits the same #F8F8F8 canvas as both neighbours; borders remain zero.
